summary: Iteration 8 comprehensive testing complete for multi-club registration, tenant isolation, /payments page (unpaid list + collect flow), unlinked underpayment (no more 400), minute-wise billing, and ratio-of-total per-player table split. All 16 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend register→dashboard flow, club-name header uppercase, 4 seeded tables, Payments page tabs, player-wise filter, Details modal, Collect modal (partial→full), and absence of pay-split-equal button all verified via Playwright. No blockers.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — a11y-only, does not affect functionality. Consider adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to satisfy Radix a11y contract.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription to CollectModal and InvoiceModal to silence Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _ScopedCollection is correctly scoping every read/write by current_club (set on login/register/get_current_user). Tenant isolation verified end-to-end: new club's player+invoice not visible to default admin, and new club sees only its own user.
server.py register() (~L458): seeds 4 tables/2 memberships/4 inventory/settings via seed_club_defaults; players+invoices empty; settings.business_name==club_name — all verified.

server.py compute_session_billing (L369-424): per-player table_share is now `total_table_amount * (ratio / sum_ratios)` — presence_seconds is computed but not used as a weight, matching the new spec 'ratio of TOTAL table bill (not weighted by join time)'. Verified 1:1→50/50 and 2:1→66.67/33.33 even when player B joined mid-session.
server.py _entry_billable_seconds (L322): `// 60 * 60` floors to completed minutes — 1900s (31m40s) → 1860s and amount 320/60*31=165.33 — exact match.
server.py close_session (L1024): credit_amount computed for BOTH linked & unlinked sessions; no 400 raised for unlinked underpayment. walk_in_sale (L939) same behavior. Both verified.

server.py /invoices/unpaid (L1117): groups by player_id or 'walkin:<lowername>' for unlinked — matches Payments.jsx keyOf(). Response includes total_due, count, invoices, by_player[due,billed,paid,invoices]. Verified.

server.py /invoices/{iid}/collect (L1133): full validation - rejects settled (400), over-collect (400), amount<=0 (400). On linked player decrements credit_balance by amt and inserts credit_payments doc with invoice_id. On full collect status→paid, credit→0. Payments array entries include collected_at. All verified.

Payments.jsx: keyOf uses same normalization as backend. data-testids in place: payments-total-due, payments-tab-unpaid, payments-tab-all, payments-player-<key>, bill-view-<num>, bill-collect-<num>, collect-due, collect-amount, collect-method, collect-save. All wired correctly.
CloseTableModal.jsx: pay-split-equal button removed as required (verified via DOM query). close-unpaid-note appears when credit>0. Generate Bill for unlinked underpayment succeeds.
Minor: /api/auth/register returns admin role but does not enforce club_name uniqueness (two clubs could share the same display name). Usernames ARE globally unique, so this is cosmetic only.

Minor: On preview-bill fetch and refresh() in CloseTableModal, ratiosInit gate prevents re-syncing when players are added mid-session; ratios can appear stale until modal reopens. Not blocking (backend recomputes on close).
test_credentials: admin/admin123, cashier/cashier123 (default club); dynamic registered UI/API test clubs use ui_test_<hex>/test_club_<hex> with password secret123
seed_data_creation: New registered TEST/UI clubs left in DB (isolated, harmless). Under default club: TEST_ITR8_* players + several TEST_ closed unpaid/partial invoices remain (used by shared fixtures; consistent with prior iterations' pattern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 fully green. Multi-tenant scoping via _ScopedCollection is bulletproof for the tested endpoints. Registration seeds all defaults idempotently. Unpaid+collect flow is complete: partial collect keeps status=partial and decrements player.credit_balance + writes credit_payments doc with invoice_id; full collect zeros credit and status=paid; over-collect and collect-on-settled both 400. Minute-wise billing: `bill_secs = floor(elapsed/60)*60`, amount = rate/60*minutes. Per-player table_share is `total_table_amount * ratio/sum_ratios` (presence ignored, as spec). CloseTableModal 'Fill Full' still exists but pay-split-equal removed. Run tests: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_iter8_multiclub_payments.py -v`.
